name: Electricity Generating Public Company Limited
summary: Electricity Generating Public Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, generates and sells electricity to government sector and industrial users primarily in Thailand, Laos, the Philippines, Indonesia, Australia, South Korea, Taiwan, and the United States. It operates through Electricity Generation and Other Businesses segments. The company generates electricity from various resources, such as biomass, hydropower, solar and wind power, battery energy, and fuel cell. It also involved in operation, maintenance, engineering and construction services to power plants, petrochemical plants, oil refineries and other industries; coal mining, management, and oil pipeline business.
